context_for_next_testing_agent: MRP improvements verified: (1) Items with on_hand >= gross_requirement are filtered out from MRP demand. (2) PO status tracking works with three states: pending (no PO), partial_po (PO covers part of net_requirement), po_sent (PO covers full net_requirement). (3) Frontend shows correct badges with colors: green for PO Sent, yellow for Partial PO, red for Pending. (4) Fixed bug in server.py where PO lookup was searching 'items.item_id' but POs use 'lines' field - now searches both for compatibility.

mrp_stock_filter.details: Items with on_hand >= gross_requirement are NOT shown in MRP demand. Verified by creating large SO (qty 500) which created shortage, then cancelling to restore stock coverage.

mrp_po_status_tracking.details: MRP demand includes po_status (pending/partial_po/po_sent), po_ordered_qty, and remaining_to_order fields. Status logic: pending when po_ordered_qty=0, partial_po when 0 < po_ordered_qty < net_requirement, po_sent when po_ordered_qty >= net_requirement.

mrp_po_status_badges.details: Frontend shows correct badges: 'PO Sent (qty)' with green background, 'Partial PO (ordered/total)' with yellow background, 'Pending' with red background. Row backgrounds also colored appropriately.

mrp_grn_auto_remove.details: When stock is replenished (via GRN or any means) to cover gross_requirement, item automatically disappears from MRP demand. Verified by cancelling test SO which restored stock coverage.

mrp_summary_card.details: Items with Demand KPI count matches the filtered demand list length.
